agriculture.name: Agriculture
books: Principles of Agronomy by S.R. Reddy
Plant Breeding: Principles and Methods by B.D. Singh
Introductory Soil Science by D.K. Das
Plant Physiology by S.N. Pandey and B.K. Sinha
agriculture.summary: Agriculture is an applied and heavily factual science optional that blends core biological disciplines like genetics and physiology with field-oriented topics such as agronomy, soil science, and rural farm economics.

animal-husbandry-and-veterinary-science.name: Animal Husbandry and Veterinary Science
books: Principles of Animal Nutrition and Feed Technology by D.V. Reddy
Textbook of Animal Husbandry by G.C. Banerjee
Animal Physiology by William O. Reece
Veterinary Medicine by D.C. Blood and O.M. Radostits
animal-husbandry-and-veterinary-science.summary: Animal Husbandry and Veterinary Science is a highly technical, fact-intensive discipline that rewards candidates with a relevant biological or veterinary background through precise, diagram-rich, and objective answers.

anthropology.name: Anthropology
books: Anthropology by Carol R. Ember, Melvin Ember, and Peter N. Peregrine
An Introduction to Social Anthropology by D.N. Majumdar and T.N. Madan
Physical Anthropology by P. Nath
Indian Anthropology by Nadeem Hasnain
Tribal India by Nadeem Hasnain
anthropology.summary: Anthropology bridges biological sciences and socio-cultural studies, offering a structured, diagram-friendly, and well-resourced syllabus centered on human evolution, society, and Indian tribal dynamics.

botany.name: Botany
books: Plant Physiology by Lincoln Taiz and Eduardo Zeiger
Plant Pathology by P.D. Sharma
A Textbook of Botany by Singh, Pande and Jain
Economic Botany by S.L. Kochhar
botany.summary: Botany is an objective and diagram-intensive biological science optional that rewards strong factual recall, clear morphological understanding, and consistent practice with scientific illustrations.

chemistry.name: Chemistry
books: Principles of Physical Chemistry by B.R. Puri, L.R. Sharma, and M.S. Pathania
Concise Inorganic Chemistry by J.D. Lee
Organic Chemistry by Jonathan Clayden, Nick Greeves, and Stuart Warren
A Guidebook to Mechanism in Organic Chemistry by Peter Sykes
chemistry.summary: Chemistry is a rigorous, objective optional requiring mastery over mathematical problem-solving in physical chemistry, structural trends in inorganic chemistry, and precise reaction mechanisms in organic chemistry.

civil-engineering.name: Civil Engineering
books: Strength of Materials by S. Ramamrutham and R. Narayanan
Basic and Applied Soil Mechanics by Gopal Ranjan and A.S.R. Rao
Limit State Design of Reinforced Concrete by P.C. Varghese
Hydraulics and Fluid Mechanics Including Hydraulics Machines by P.N. Modi and S.M. Seth
civil-engineering.summary: Civil Engineering is an exhaustive, calculation-driven optional that heavily rewards methodical numerical problem-solving, structural design skills, and clear technical drafting.

commerce-and-accountancy.name: Commerce and Accountancy
books: Financial Management: Theory and Practice by Prasanna Chandra
Cost Accounting: Principles and Practice by M.N. Arora
Organizational Behaviour by Stephen P. Robbins
Human Resource Management by K. Aswathappa
commerce-and-accountancy.summary: Commerce and Accountancy is a structured, scoring subject that pairs technical problem-solving in accounting, taxation, and finance with conceptual frameworks in organizational management.

economics.name: Economics
books: Advanced Economic Theory by H.L. Ahuja
Macroeconomics: Theories and Policies by Richard T. Froyen
International Economics by Dominick Salvatore
Economic Growth and Development by Debraj Ray
Indian Economy: Performance and Policies by Uma Kapila
economics.summary: Economics pairs rigorous theoretical modeling and diagrammatic analysis in Paper 1 with an empirical, policy-oriented assessment of India's historical and contemporary economic development in Paper 2.

electrical-engineering.name: Electrical Engineering
books: Electric Machinery by P.S. Bimbhra
Modern Control Engineering by Katsuhiko Ogata
Power System Engineering by I.J. Nagrath and D.P. Kothari
Signals and Systems by Alan V. Oppenheim, Alan S. Willsky, and S. Hamid Nawab
electrical-engineering.summary: A technical and calculation-intensive optional characterized by an objective scoring pattern that demands rigorous mathematical derivation, circuit diagramming, and numerical problem-solving.

geography.name: Geography
books: Physical Geography by Savindra Singh
Models in Geography by Majid Husain
Evolution of Geographical Thought by Majid Husain
India: A Comprehensive Geography by D.R. Khullar
geography.summary: Geography bridges earth sciences and spatial socio-economic planning, demanding systematic conceptual clarity alongside extensive mapwork and diagrammatic representation.

geology.name: Geology
books: A Textbook of Geology by P.K. Mukherjee
Principals of Engineering Geology by K.M. Bangar
Structural Geology by Marland P. Billings
Economic Geology: Economic Mineral Deposits by Umeshwar Prasad
geology.summary: Geology is a structured, highly objective earth-science optional that demands precise factual recall, spatial visualization, and extensive use of neat geological sketches and maps.

history.name: History
books: A History of Ancient and Early Medieval India by Upinder Singh
History of Medieval India by Satish Chandra
From Plassey to Partition and After: A History of Modern India by Sekhar Bandyopadhyay
Mastering Modern World History by Norman Lowe
history.summary: History is a vast, narrative-driven optional that requires synthesizing diverse historiographical perspectives, memorizing extensive factual chronologies, and mastering historical map pointing.

law.name: Law
books: Indian Constitutional Law by M.P. Jain
Public International Law by S.K. Kapoor
PSA Pillai's Criminal Law by K.I. Vibhute
Law of Contract & Specific Relief by Avtar Singh
The Law of Torts by Ratanlal and Dhirajlal
law.summary: Studying Law demands rigorous retention of statutory provisions, landmark case laws, and legal doctrines, paired with analytical precision to resolve complex constitutional, international, and civil disputes.

literature-kannada.name: Literature of Kannada
books: Kannada Sahitya Charitre by R. S. Mugali
Bharatiya Kavya Meemamse by Ti. Nam. Srikantaiah
Karnataka Samskruti Sameekshe by H. Thipperudraswamy
Hosagannada Sahitya Charitre by L. S. Seshagiri Rao
literature-kannada.summary: The subject involves analyzing the linguistic evolution, socio-cultural history, and aesthetic richness of Kannada through classical epics, Bhakti movements, and modern literary traditions.

literature-kashmiri.name: Literature of Kashmiri
books: Kashri Adbuk Twarikh by Avtar Krishna Rehbar
A History of Kashmiri Literature by Trilokinath Raina
A Grammar of Kashmiri Language by Omkar N. Koul
Lal Ded by Jayalal Kaul
literature-kashmiri.summary: Studying Kashmiri Literature combines foundational linguistics and dialectology of the language with an analytical exploration of mystical vakhs, classical poetry, folklore, and modern literary genres.

literature-konkani.name: Literature of Konkani
books: Konkani Bhashecho Itihas by Shenoi Goembab
Konkani Sahityacho Itihas by ManoharRai SarDessai
A History of Konkani Literature by ManoharRai SarDessai
Konkani Bhasha Vignan by B. B. Borkar
literature-konkani.summary: Konkani Literature offers a focused and compact syllabus centered on linguistic evolution, regional sociocultural history, and the textual critique of classical and modern literary works.

literature-maithili.name: Literature of Maithili
books: Maithili Sahityak Itihas by Durganath Jha Shreesh
History of Maithili Literature by Jayakanta Mishra
Maithili Bhashak Vikas by Subhadra Jha
Vidyapati Padavali edited by Narendra Jha
literature-maithili.summary: Maithili literature offers a compact, well-defined syllabus focusing on the historical and grammatical evolution of the language alongside close textual analysis of classical and modern literary works.

literature-malayalam.name: Literature of Malayalam
books: Malayala Bhasha Charithram by P. Govinda Pillai
Kairaliyude Katha by N. Krishna Pillai
Malayala Sahithya Charithram by P. K. Parameswaran Nair
Bhashacharithra Charcha by Dr. Godavarma
literature-malayalam.summary: Malayalam Literature demands fluency in written Malayalam, deep textual engagement with classical and modern literary works, and a critical appreciation of regional linguistic and sociopolitical evolution.

literature-manipuri.name: Literature of Manipuri
books: A History of Manipuri Literature by Ch. Manihar Singh
Manipuri Grammar by P. C. Thoudam
Aspects of Manipuri Culture by E. Nilakanta Singh
Manipuri Sahityagi Itihas by N. Tombi Singh
literature-manipuri.summary: Studying Manipuri literature involves exploring linguistics, folklore, cultural traditions, and close textual appreciation of classical and modern literary works in the Meitei Mayek or Bengali scripts.
